site_schema.summary: The schema presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and software-development provider rather than the approved staffing and recruiting agency. It also describes obsolete development offers and includes multiple unsupported service claims, timelines, guarantees, and founder claims.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI engineering positioning
llm_problems.issue: The schema positions GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that turns engineering into AI-native production, contrary to the approved staffing and recruiting description.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning with the approved company description and describe only GoGloby's staffing and recruiting services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner
GoGloby turns engineering into AI-native production.

llm_problems.title: Discontinued AI development services
llm_problems.issue: The schema sells Applied AI Engineering and generative AI delivery, including building copilots, agents, and RAG applications, which are development services rather than GoGloby's recruiting and staffing offers.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the development-service offers and retain only the two approved recruiting and staffing services.
